title: Boundary-rank obstructions and measurement-assisted recovery in dissipative flat-band preparation
summary: Number-conserving cooling can fail to prepare an interacting flat-band target when Pauli exclusion blocks its transfer destinations. We study this failure on vertex-edge decorated graphs at one particle per flat orbital. The rank of a cut block of the flat-orbital Gram matrix bounds the number of residual source directions that can remain flat. For sublinear-range cooling with no Hamiltonian term, separated spin domains on periodic decorated hypercubic lattices support exponentially many stationary states with a nonzero bright-particle density.
